exclusions: General organizational, leadership, equity, architecture, deployment and maintenance discussion is not selected unless it explains code, documentation, naming, tests, contracts, or comment practice.

Review-conversation comments and bug-tracker discussions are distinguished from source-code comments. Pure review-UI operations, approval workflow, and conversation counts are excluded; passages directly connecting reviews to code explanation/history are retained.

Index/TOC repeated navigation labels, bibliographic metadata, publisher requests for reader comments, URL // characters, Bazel // paths, and uses of document to mean processed search/input data are not independent comment positions.
Diagram-only system topology, test hierarchy, release/build workflow, and resource-tradeoff figures contain no additional source-comment specimens; all 40 referenced PNGs were visually inspected.
unresolved_gaps: The reading text linearizes HTML inline markup, table cells and lists and does not preserve every code indentation or table column. Original HTML remains the authority; structural checks covered the two ch07 tables and preformatted specimens in ch08/ch10/ch12/ch18, not every page rendered in a browser.

Figure 17-4 has a horizontally clipped query. Its visible portion and embedded code are supplemented; absent text is not reconstructed. Figure 20-1 supplement omits UI controls and the naming-warning regular expression, distinguishing the human review comment from source comments.
Figures 23-4 and 23-5 were visually inspected as context for tracked test disablement, but graph curves remain in the original images; no data values were inferred or fully transcribed.
